name: og-vent-specificity
title: Vent Specificity: Are the Gates Vent-Specific or Generic?
concept: Specificity of the origin scenario: whether the campaign's discriminating gates detect the serpentinizing alkaline vent specifically, or would pass for any generic non-equilibrium drive — tested as a common CROSS-STUDY ABLATION MATRIX (the real og-01/02/03 composites run with each vent feature ablated: no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S interface, no pore concentration), plus a PLANNED competing-environments falsification. A null control: a REFUTED generic null is the desired, positive result. Important bound: the ablation matrix shows the gates reject a feature-stripped generic drive, but GENUINE vent specificity requires positive, realistic ALTERNATIVE-ENVIRONMENT models — which are planned, not yet run — so specificity is demonstrated against ablation, not yet against competing origin environments.
gate_reason: Null control (vent specificity). Consolidates the adversarial control (og-adv, canonical) and the planned competing-environments falsification (og-ev-competing-environments). Headline (og-adv, canonical): running the real og-01/02/03 composites with the vent's characteristic features ablated — no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalytic interface, no pore concentration — makes them fail all five discriminating gates (carbon flux, formate yield, protometabolic throughput, thermophoretic Peclet, enrichment), while the vent passes each. The campaign's gates are therefore vent-specific detectors, not generic non-equilibrium detectors: the generic-nonequilibrium null hypothesis is REFUTED (correctly rejected by every gate). This refutation is the desired result of an adversarial control — it certifies the gates discriminate the vent rather than any drive, and gate_status=passed because the control works as designed. Building it also exposed and fixed a latent control-integrity bug (catalyst_active=0 silently swallowed by process-bigraph is_empty). og-ev-competing-environments (planned) extends the falsification to competing origin environments.
claim: The campaign's discriminating gates are specific to the serpentinizing alkaline vent, not to generic non-equilibrium. Run with the vent's characteristic features ablated (no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalyst, no pore concentration), the same real og-01/02/03 composites fail all five gates (carbon flux, formate yield, protometabolic throughput, thermophoretic Peclet, enrichment) while the vent passes each — the generic-nonequilibrium null is refuted by every gate (og-adv, canonical; verdict=refuted = null correctly rejected, gate_status=passed = the control discriminates). A planned competing-environments study extends the falsification. Consolidated: the gates detect this vent, not any drive — specificity demonstrated via a refuted-by-design null. Every matched null and arm verdict kept.
question: Do the campaign's discriminating gates detect the serpentinizing alkaline vent specifically, or would any generic non-equilibrium drive pass them?
hypothesis: The gates are vent-specific — ablating the vent's characteristic features (sustained H2, Fe/Ni/S catalyst, pore concentration) makes the real composites fail them, so a generic non-equilibrium drive does not reproduce the vent chemistry.
experiment: Consolidate the vent-specificity control(s) into one concept with the adversarial ablation control (og-adv, canonical) and the planned competing-environments falsification as arms, preserving the refuted-by-design null verdict; report that the gates discriminate the vent (generic null refuted).
result: The campaign's gates are vent-specific — ablating the vent's features makes the real composites fail all five gates while the vent passes, so the generic-nonequilibrium null is refuted (correctly rejected) and specificity is demonstrated. A latent catalyst_active=0 control-integrity bug was found and fixed building the control.

arms.concept_role: Canonical (adversarial null control): run the real og-01/02/03 composites with the vent's characteristic features ablated — no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalytic interface, no pore concentration — and they fail all five discriminating gates (carbon flux, formate yield, protometabolic throughput, thermophoretic Peclet, enrichment) while the vent passes each. The gates are therefore vent-specific detectors, not generic non-equilibrium detectors: the generic-nonequilibrium null is REFUTED (correctly rejected). verdict=refuted is the desired result of an adversarial control. (Building it exposed and fixed a latent control-integrity bug: catalyst_active=0 silently swallowed by process-bigraph is_empty.)
Planned cross-cutting falsification: do competing origin environments (not the alkaline serpentinizing vent) also pass the gates — extends the specificity control beyond the ablation null? (not run)

behavior_tests.description: Every vent-specific gate (og-01/02/03) rejects the feature-ablated control — it passes by being rejected.

measure.detail: run og-01/02/03 gates on the generic control; each measured value below its threshold

behavior_tests.name: vent-specificity-demonstrated
behavior_tests.description: The vent passes the same five gates the control fails — pass-where-control-fails.

measure.detail: vent vs generic on identical gates

pass_if.detail: vent passes 5/5 where the control fails 5/5

findings.statement: Every vent-specific gate rejects the generic control. Running the real og-01/02/03 composites with no sustained H2, no Fe/Ni/S catalyst and no pore concentration, all five discriminating gates fall below threshold — net C-flux 4e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; formate ~0 vs 50 mM; protometabolic throughput 3e-13 vs 1e-6 mol/s; accumulation Péclet 0.26 vs 18; enrichment 1.3 (generic) vs the vent clearing the ≥10⁶-fold gate (a reduced-model magnitude, solver-sensitive above Pe ≈ 13; see og-03) — the tightest by 1.8 decades. The vent passes all five.

evidence.observed: min rejection margin 1.84 decades (tightest gate: og-03 accumulation Péclet, generic 0.26 < 18); all 5 gates reject generic, vent passes all 5

findings.explanation: The vent features are PARAMETERS on the same real composites, so the control is a parameterization of the vent models, not a hand-tuned mock. No dissolved H2 → no CO2 reduction; no Fe/Ni/S interface → no abiotic carbon fixation; an open pore → no thermophoretic concentration.

findings.statement: The gates are vent-specific detectors, not generic nonequilibrium detectors — the vent passes where the control fails on each of the five gates. A PASS therefore certifies the vent mechanism (sustained H2 + Fe/Ni/S catalysis + pore concentration), falsifying the "the gates just measure any driven chemistry" objection.

evidence.observed: vent passes 5/5 gates; generic control fails 5/5 — pass-where-control-fails on every gate

findings.explanation: Falsification exposure for the whole investigation — the headline claims would be hollow if a feature-ablated control cleared the same bars. It does not.

findings.statement: Building the control exposed a latent control-integrity bug — catalyst_active=0 was silently swallowed by process-bigraph's is_empty(Float, 0.0) and refilled with the default, so the no-catalyst control (here and in og-01's cross-run gate) secretly ran with full catalyst. Clamping to 1e-6 honors the control; og-01's gates still pass (9/9 + both cross-run) with the now-truthful control.

evidence.observed: no-catalyst formate dropped from ~0.014 mM (catalyst silently on) to ~2e-8 mM (honored); og-01 still PASS

findings.explanation: Same gotcha as og-04's mix_fraction=0; a control parameter set to exactly 0.0 must be clamped to a negligible floor so the ablation is real.

gates-reject-generic.detail: all 5 vent-specific gates REJECT the generic control (min margin 1.84 decades below threshold; tightest: og-03 accumulation Péclet generic=0.26 < 18) => the gates measure the vent mechanism, not generic nonequilibrium chemistry

vent-specificity-demonstrated.detail: the vent passes all 5 gates where the generic control fails every one => vent-specificity demonstrated (pass-where-control-fails on each gate)
